# truefoundry_system_secret_store (Resource)

Manages a TrueFoundry provider account carrying DB-backed system secret stores, applied as a `provider-account/truefoundry` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. System secret stores keep secrets in the control plane's own database — no external configuration or credentials — and back secret references like `tfy-secret://my-tenant:my-account:secret-name`. Existing accounts can be imported by their FQN, e.g. `terraform import truefoundry_system_secret_store.example my-tenant:truefoundry:my-account`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The built-in DB-backed secret store: secrets live in the control plane's
# own database and back references like tfy-secret://my-tenant:system-secret-store:secret-name.
resource "truefoundry_system_secret_store" "system" {
  name = "system-secret-store"

  secret_stores = [
    {
      name                = "system-secret-store"
      authorized_subjects = ["team:everyone"]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the TrueFoundry account (3-32 characters, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens). Changing it replaces the account.
- `secret_stores` (Attributes Set) DB-backed secret stores in this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secret_stores))

### Read-Only

- `fqn` (String) Fully qualified name of the TrueFoundry account.
- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the TrueFoundry account.

<a id="nestedatt--secret_stores"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secret_stores`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name identifying this secret store.

Optional:

- `authorized_subjects` (Set of String) Subjects allowed to use this secret store, as `<user_type>:<username>` FQNs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# System secret stores are imported by their FQN: <tenant>:truefoundry:<name>.
terraform import truefoundry_system_secret_store.system my-tenant:truefoundry:system-secret-store
```
